verdict.rationale: Acting as an MCP client is a fair question for an API client with AI features, so the axis applies. The pack shows no evidence that Hoppscotch can connect to or consume external MCP servers' tools. The documented MCP server (docs-32, probe-3) is the opposite, server-side role, and the AI features (docs-35) cover only built-in tasks like renaming requests and generating payloads.
